batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c IK Pathan b VR Aaron

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c SB Jakati b JA Morkel

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c M Vijay b DJ Bravo

batting.name: CA Ingram
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b R Ashwin

batting.name: JR Hopes
batting.dismissal: c MEK Hussey b DJ Bravo

batting.name: AB McDonald
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b DE Bollinger

balls.text: another one, Irfan bowls one more full toss, Dhoni goes hard for the pull and the ball disappears over deep square leg
Dhoni murders a low full toss over deep midwicket, flat and furious, Irfan targets the blockhole, misses and pays the price
yorker from Irfan, excellent ball, Dhoni jabs it down to long on, rushes back for the second, Badri cannot get back there in time as the throw comes in
mistimes the big swing over midwicket towards long on
Dhoni gets to the 50 with a flick off his toes through midwicket off 28 deliveries, raises the bat to acknowledge the cheers of "Dhoni, Dhoni"
slower bouncer angled across the batsman, Dhoni gets on his toes to pull it hard wide of deep midwicket, and they get back for the second
bangs in the short ball and Badri goes for the pull now, for the umpteenth time a top edge manages to evade the field, this one falls in front of Aaron coming to his right at long leg
Agarkar has lost the plot in his last over completely, low full this time, wide outside off stump, Badri wills it past backward point with a delicate steer
full toss, Badri capitalises, stands erect and turns the face to time it high over deep midwicket, pure timing, super shot from Badri
plays a murderous pull shot but right to the man at deep midwicket

this could be the over, Dhoni stays in the crease, gets a fuller one, and just lifts it high over the off side, sweeper cover watches it sail over him, graceful  from Dhoni, not many times you can use that word about him
looks to launch a length ball over midwicket, but it hurries on to him and he mistimes it towards the man in the circle, Badri has not been at his best today
Dhoni gets the boundary off the last ball, Aaron targeted the blockhole but it ended up as a low full toss, Dhoni swatted it straight down the ground, long on's dive was in vain
goes for the forcing pull off a length ball, and ends up hitting it to long on
the short delivery, comes slowly off the surface and is widish as well, he reaches out to cut it to sweeper cover
very low full toss at 134.3 kph, almost in the blockhole, he tries to drive it away on the off side but cannot beat point
Aaron loses his line and his length this time, bowls it full and wide down the leg side, bounces after it passes the stumps
Badri gets one away, shuffles across, turns in the crease, and picks up the length ball over square leg and in to the boundary
full ball angled in to Dhoni's pads, he lunges forward attempting to hit it through midwicket, but misses and is hit on the pads
another full delivery, superb over from Irfan, Dhoni drives it to sweeper cover
goes for a big swipe, cannot connect cleanly but gets the single to bring Dhoni on strike
yorker, even Dhoni cannot do much about it, just digs it away for a single
full this time on the pads, flicked away in the air to deep midwicket
Badri goes for the pull off a very high full toss, but gets it down towards long off, no worries, Dhoni charges back for the second
low full toss first up and he bends the knee to swing it hard down the ground, long on cuts it off
full in the blockhole, he gets in to a tangle but manages to squeeze it away to midwicket
cheeky from dhoni, walks across, takes it from middle stump and turns the wrists to send it in the air but well past short fine leg
too much of the short of a length stuff today, this one is shorter, Dhoni needs no invitation, rocks back and plays a belter of a pull that sends the ball in to the deep midwicket boundary
angled in on the pads, skids off a length, Badri tries to make room and flick it away but takes it on the pads
Dhoni gets the single down to sweeper cover again
another top edge falls in no man's land, there have been a few today, another short ball in to the body, goes for the pull, the edge falls in front of long leg running in
short of a length outside off stump and punched away to sweeper cover
goes hard at it and gets it down to long off for a run
low and quick full toss, he hits it hard towards deep mdiwicket
Badri is beaten again, with that full length from over the wicket
stumping missed, Badri almost yorks himself as he comes down the track, Ojha cannot gather the ball cleanly, Delhi's poor day in the field continues
as straight as it gets, Badri takes a step out, gets to the pitch and lofts it in front of the sightscreen
Dhoni plays a furious swipe to this full delivery, but Warner cuts it off running to his right from long on
Dhoni walks across the stumps to work a short of a length ball from middle stump to long leg
hurries him in the pull with the sharp bouncer dug in to the body, the top edge falls in the vacant square leg region
goes back to the short length again, this one goes away from the batsman wide outside off, tries to guide it to third man, again beaten by the bounce
140.9 kph, this one is much fuller, Badri crashes it off the front foot but straight to mid off
makes a bit of room outside leg and looks to cut this back of a length ball, is beaten by the bounce
Dhoni pushes a length ball away to mid off and easily makes the single as fielder cannot pick up the ball cleanly
very low full toss on leg, he hits it along the ground to long on
as deft as it gets, goes on the back foot, and steers it late almost off the keeper's gloves, but short third man is there
good work from Irfan on the long on boundary, it was a full toss smashed down the ground but Irfan;s dive saved the boundary
slides in with the arm, Dhoni goes back to swing it down to deep square leg
fuller one, he pushes off the front foot in to the covers
Badri gets this away, neatly done, makes room and opens the face to crack it between short third man and backward point
slower one and wide outside off stump, got away with it, Dhoni was late in picking it, tried to reach out and guide it late, but missed
shuffles again but this time he gets bat to ball to work it in front of square leg
Badri has been shuffling way across this innings, again he cannot get the flick off the pads, ball rolls away on the leg side
driven towards mid on now for a single
Dhoni goes hard at a length ball from the back foot, it is the off cutter, Dhoni also opens the face at the last moment to run it fine on the off side
Dhoni was waiting, he was waiting, gentle full delivery, Dhoni wallops it powerfully over the sight screen with a big followthrough
goes short this time and Dhoni rocks on the back foot and punches hard to sweeper cover
angled in from a length on middle and leg, Dhoni reaches out to push it back to Ajit
Ajit gives Dhoni the sharp bouncer, Dhoni goes hard at the pull right away, and the top edge flies wide of long leg
full delivery on middle and played out to mid off

what a well-timed catch from Venu, Ajit gets away with a low full toss, not for the first time in his career, Vijay had stepped back, leaned and swung it right off the middle of the bat, and it seemed headed for another maximum before Rao got on his toes and took a head-high catch inches from the ropes
120.5 kph slower and fuller one angled in on middle and leg, pushed away towards mid on for a run
walks across the stumps and looks to swing a length ball over square leg, but gets it off the toe end of the bat in front of square leg
high full toss, how well BAdri has handled this, adjusts to push it in the air over the infield and for a boundary wide of long off
goes for the pull straight away to the short ball but there is a man at deep square leg
gets an inside edge as he looks to push it away but gets the single
another one stops on Vijay, this time he almost hits it back to the bowler, takes a single as it rolls down the ground
what a shot! Vijay gets a full ball on middle, and whips it in the air, that seemed to stop a bit on him, but his timing has been so good that it fairly flew in to the wide long on boundary
fires this one in quicker, Badri gets in to a tangle as he wants to flick it away, gets hit on the pads
pushes this one off the front foot to extra cover
another one on leg stump it tucked away for a single in front of square
goes back to flick it away through midwicket, they come back for the second as well, good running
brings bat around pad to work it away to short fine leg
Badri will do this all day, gets inside the line, and lofts with that high elbow over extra cover, splitting the gap between sweeper cover and long off
hello, walks way outside off stump to pick it away over fine leg, cannot connect, but they pinch a tight run as the ball rolls away close to the stumps
strides forward and pushes a fuller one away to mid off with a flourish, was looking to go much squarer
one more short delivery angled in to the body, almost as if he is expecting it he connects with the pull, but does not time it well enough, midwicket fields
Badri gets the single behind point this time
Delhi have been bowling consistently short, Vijay goes for the pull, is not in control but gets it away towards deep square leg
fields on his followthrough as a back of a length ball is pushed to him
good over from Nadeem, but that drop, that drop is going to hurt, this one is hit to point
stretches well forward and pushes out to covers
sharp turn and bounce on this one from short of a length, he looked to work it away but could not
Badri gets fully forward, pushes to covers and takes off, Vijay is going nowhere, he is right, there is no run, BAdri gets back just in time as the throw comes in
punched off the back foot to long off
another drop simple chance, this one stops on the batsman who pushes hard at it and it travels at a nice height to NAdeem who clangs it, Delhi have no one to blame but themselves
dropped cracked by Vijay, he backed away a shade and just smoked this fuller one, Hopes it was at cover who got to the screamer with a dive but put it down, how much will that cost Delhi?
131.2 kph another short one, that length is working well for Aaron, angles in the bouncer, and Vijay gets out of the way fast
goes for a loose waft from the crease to one short and wide outside off stump, and is beaten
Raina falls to the short ball, Aaron bangs it in to the body, Raina instinctively goes for the pull, but ends up swinging it straight to Irfan at long leg
132.9 kph length ball on the middle stump, Raina shuffles a long way across and tickles it through square leg, Irfan comes in from long leg to field
Aaron continues with the short of a length stuff, touch outside off stump, and Raina looks to make room and carve it over cover, is beaten by the sharp bounce
122.2 kph slower one. Vijay is early in to the pull shot and the ball goes on the bounce to the keeper
this one comes slowly from short of a length, and Vijay pushes it away to point
now Ajit digs in the bouncer, vijay swerves out of the way calmly
another one, he plays this shot so well, this one was on a length, Vijay lets it come on and lofts with as clean a swing of the bat as possible over long on
this one stops a bit on Vijay as he comes forward and he ends up pushing it in the air, but well to the right of Ajit
and first ball Vijay greets him with that pick-up pull off a back of a length ball, sends it high and over the deep midwicket boundary
eased in to the gap between midwicket and mid on off the pads, but Ingram comes charging in from midwicket and his diving stop saves the runs
128.6 kph this time but well-directed short one, Vijay gets out of the way as it takes off
another one banged in short at 147.6 kph, but well outside off stump and he lets it go, keeper takes it high near the head
this one is much fuller, and Vijay times it off the front foot but straight to mid on
gets a lot of carry on this one from back of a length, he goes for the cut on the toes but is beaten
short of a length in to Raina, he adjusts to pull it away to long leg
silken touch from Vijay, full delivery on the pads, he does not over hit, does not even hit, just twirls the wrists to send it in the gap between mid on and midwicket
shortish and wide outside off stump, he wristily cuts it to third man
comes forward and pushes this length ball going across, in the air and on the bounce to cover, they take the fielder on, Vijay would have been out by  miles had the throw hit
played out on the leg side as this one comes back in from short of a length
now and then, Irfan slips in the one that goes straight on with the angle, quite a change for the batsman expecting it to come back in, and ends up pushing inside the line as it rushes past

Vijay this time, superb stroke, lets this full delivery come on, again not committing fully forward, and pushes it without much followthrough, bat and pad close together, it is timed so well that non-striker has to quickly get out of the way
played out towards point
not this time though, Raina takes toll, stands motionless till the last moment, but as the fuller one arrives, he launches it in a flash over the long on boundary
not sure whether Delhi need all the military medium from McDonald upfront, this time he gets away as Raina pushes it off the back foot to mid on
Warner has saved what could have been another four, Raina came out of his crease and pushed hard but Warner rushed to his left and dived to stop the ball
sweet punch from Raina, stands tall, at McDonald's pace, it just sits up from a length, and Raina punches it off the back foot, beating the man at extra cover
gentle length ball angled in on the pads, tucked away through square leg

that's gone! Irfan has struck in the opening over, Hussey was caught in the crease with all that movement Irfan was getting, this one was the sucker ball, did not curve away, went straight on from a length, and Hussey was too late to adjust, the ball crashed in to the pads and Hussey is gone
angled in on middle and leg, played out quietly on the on side
shot! Irfan pitches it much fuller this time, Hussey stays in the crease, gets beside the line, and creams it past the man at extra cover
continues to bend the ball back in, this one is short of a length, allows Vijay to go back and tuck it in front of square leg
well bowled Irfan, very full, almost in the blockhole, curving in to Vijay, who does not commit full forward and digs it out as it comes in
gets the shape away from the left-hander right away, but it pitches a touch wide and Hussey cracks it, diving stop at point saves the boundary

well, that's how this game has been, Chennai threw down the gauntlet, but Delhi forgot to pick it up, Dougie bangs in the short ball, and Nagar calmly bends the knee, keeps the bat down and gets out of the way
pulled away to deep square leg for a single
Irfan is getting some good hits away, but it is way too late, shuffles across and pulls a short of a length ball over long leg
welcomed with a short ball, looks to weave away from the line, but the ball takes the splice and loops in the air on the off side, Dhoni tries to get there in time but can't reach it
Saha gets in to the game, McDonald backs away and guides the full delivery straight to Saha on the sweeper cover boundary, didn't have to move at all
more short stuff and more pulling, more work for the man at deep square leg
another boundary, slightly short and Irfan pulls it behind square leg, easily beating the man running in from long leg
low full toss and Irfan gets it away, swinging it past Bravo at deep square leg
another slow-motion pull from Irfan, for a couple more to deep midwicket
lofts a fuller one from outside off high and wide of sweeper cover for a couple
Irfan bends the knee and launches in to another languid swing that is easy on the eye and goes wide of the man at deep square leg, languid he has been today, and expensive with the ball
slower delivery, pushed away towards mid off
wants to swat a length ball over midwicket, but gets only an edge that goes towards mid off, Chennai have choked Delhi off completely, without any fuss
slower bouncer, he makes room to flat-bat it over mid off, almost ends up hitting it in to Hussey's hands at mid off, on the bounce to him
swivels for the pull but takes the short one on the body as he misses the ball, there has been so much short stuff from both teams today, the only difference was Dhoni
short of a length and swatted over midwicket wide of the man at long on
slogged down the ground to long on for a single

Hussey takes a brilliant catch running in from mid off, it was the bouncer, he had backed away to swat it over the infield, but got a top edge that seemed to be falling in no man's land behind the bowler, but Hussey came rushing and took the catch, sliding on the ground on his knees
gets this one away finally, full delivery outside off stump, Irfan lofts it well over the man at mid off
Irfan looks to pull from outside off stump without any movement of the feet, ball bounces past him in to Dhoni;s gloves
fuller now outside off, he remains in the crease and guides it past point
makes room outside leg stump to punch a short of a length ball wide of sweeper cover
wide outside off stump, he reaches out to throw his bat at it, but the ball falls between backward point and third man
Irfan plays a languid-looking pull from the crease through square leg, Delhi need more, much more
reverse sweep now, to deep point, Hopes gets back for the second
pulled away to deep midwicket for a single

dropped Saha gets a chance to do something in the game and clangs a tough chance, Irfan finally connected one well enough, it stayed in the air for some time before coming down to Saha at long off,  who tried to take it but parried it over the ropes
tossed up ball around leg stump, Irfan cannot connect with the attempted sweep
tucked away in front of square leg for a single
Ashwin strikes right away, flights it, draws Venu down the track, he looks to swing it with the turn, but misses it completely, the ball turns in to put the off stump in Dhoni;s gloves
Irfan is struggling to put bat to ball, flighted one, he wants to mow it over cow corner, but will have to connect first, does not this time
fired wide down leg, Venu does not even attempt to play it, Dhoni cannot collect, and they steal a bye as the ball rolls away towards short fine leg
cut away to Badri at sweeper cover for a single
goes for another one big one on the leg side, mishits this one, it is in the air for a long time but deep square leg thinks he cannot get to it in time and takes it on the bounce
crash! Venu goes high over the leg side this time, tossed up full around leg stump, and he swings it high over deep midwicket
goes for the sweep, gets a bottom edge that is cut off by short fine leg,
slows it down as he sees him walking out, pushed back to the bowler
fuller and on the stumps now, he drives it hard past the bowler
Venu continues to get the boundary, lofts this full and wide ball well wide of sweeper cover
pulled in slow motion, rocks back, and hits it away to deep midiwicket
turning away outside off stump, Irfan goes for the cut, is beaten, Dhoni thinks it is an edge, no one else thinks so
sees him walk down the track, shortens the length, slows it down, and hits him on the pads
Raina continues to tie the batsmen down, this one is played out to midwicket as it turns in
goes for it again, and this time gets it away to short fine leg for the single
turning in from outside leg, goes for the sweep but cannot connect

caught by Suraj Randiv in the dug out, Rao skips down the track, lofts Jakati high over long off, beats Raina there who rushes back and takes down du Plessis in the dug out with his momentum, Randiv coolly takes the catch
comes down the track, takes it on the full and swings it away to deep square leg, could not connect properly
comes forward and pushes away to extra cover, Rao wants one but is sent back rightly
and is swept away off a very full length to deep square leg
guided behind point for a single
angled wide down the leg side from a length
110.8 kph slower and fuller one, Rao lofts it over the off side infield, Hussey pedals back and almost takes it at mid off, just over his hands
brings bat down from a big backlift to push a fuller one away towards covers
short again, can;t do much with it, drops it in front of point for a single
angled in back of a length, he underedges the pull wide of deep midwicket
hops on his toes to tuck a back of a length ball in front of square leg
fired in flat and full, he pushes it with the turn to long on
driven down the ground to long on
almost another one, RAina has bowled a super spell, leading edge falls short of point
looks to swing it fine down the leg side, but misses
ticked fine off the pads, Doug goes haring after it from short fine leg and pulls it back with a lunging dive
this one is bowled slower through the air, he gets forward and pushes it down the track
fired in flat on the pads, tucked away to short fine leg, direct hit and it would have been tight
124.5 kph, terrific end to a good over from Dwayne, draws Irfan tentatively poking forward and beats him with one that zips past from a length
surprises him with another sharp bouncer, he fends it in the air towards point

this one is the bouncer at normal pace, Warner is ready with the pull and eagerly hammers it, there is Vijay at deep midwicket, the ball flies to him, and he initially overruns it before adjusting to take a neat catch as he goes down
pushed away towards extra cover
the slower bouncer, he is already waiting for the pull, adjusts at the last moment to pull it along the ground to deep midwicket
short of a length, guided off the back foot to squarish third man
from round the stumps, digs it in short and wide enough to be called one

another loud shout for leg before, he is getting in trouble hanging back to Raina, this one hurries on with the angle to strike him in front of leg, Raina is convinced, Saheba isnt, replays show it just grazing leg stump, Saheba is right again
angled down the leg side from round the stumps, looks to nudge it fine but short fine leg cuts it off
pushed down the ground towards long on
goes back and gets it away off the pads through square leg

Raina was sure he had got his man, it turned a mile, batsman had no chance with it as it pitched around leg and turned across to hit him in front of middle, replays show it would have gone over the stumps, umpire Saheba got it right
tucked away towards long leg off the back foot, the throw is wide of Dhoni, and he raises his arms in disapproval
the entire range from Ashwin, the carrom ball now, tossed up outside off inviting the drive, he didn't go hard at it, that is what saved him as he got an inside edge back towards the bowler
pushed back on the off side
turning away, cut to sweeper cover
stays in the crease and tentatively pushes it towards extra cover
turns sharply across Irfan after drawing him forward with the flight, lovely delivery

Dwayne Bravo announces he has arrived in this IPL, pulls off a stunner at point, it bounced on Ingram who tried to control the cut but could not, it went in the air to Bravo;s left, but he went flying horizontal and pouched it inches from the ground
this is the danger of hanging back continuously, this one is fired in quicker,goes straight with the arm, he is hit on the pads, but that would have gone down leg, gets away this time, Raina knows it
angled down the leg side from round the wicket, takes the thigh pad on its way to Dhoni
sees him come down the track, shortens the length, and Ingram pushes it out on the off side
again he is hesitant to come forward, and pushes it towards covers from the crease
he plays another one off the backfoot, goes deep to a length ball, could have been dangerous
gets some turn from a length, he goes back to push it down the track
now this one comes slowly off the pitch, he almost plays too early, then adjusts to push it on the leg side
hurries on at 93 kph, he was on the back foot and hurriedly stabbed it away to covers
gets forward to defend towards point
comes down the track, and gets it off the pads in front of square leg
defended towards point this time
goes for the sweep from outside off stump, it hits the rough and goes low, hitting the pad, and running past the keeper in to the boundary fine on the off side
that's how the pull is played, says Warner, as he picks this short one early, swivels and delays the shot an instant to get the placement right, beating both the infield and the man in the deep
excellent delivery from Dougie, yorker at 137.6 kph around off stump, he gets bat down on it and squeezes it away to third man
goes for the pull, this time it is a 143.2 kph short one that hurries on to him, and he mistimes the shot in to the ground
110.4 kph slower one from Dougie, Warner goes back to work it away towards midwicket
shuffles across but Bollinger hits him on the pads with one that in angled in again, but marginally outside the line of off stump and pretty high too
cramps him for room with one that angles in from short of a length, jabbed back to the bowler
draws him out of the crease, Ingram realises it is futile as Ashwin drags the length back, and stops to jab the ball away towards slip
Ingram gets it away this time, stays back and lets a quicker one comes on, and cuts it late past backward point
gets forward to push it away wide of mid off for a single
bowled fuller, but he chooses to play off the back foot, and manages to cut it even as it hurries on to him
punched off the back foot but cannot beat cover again
turning away from the left-hander, pushed away to covers
Warner now, gets on top of a short delivery and pulls it away through square leg for a boundary

that is the end of Naman, he wanted to launch Morkel again beyond long off, but got too much underneath the ball this time, it was the slower one, and he swung it almost vertically in the air, Jakati settled under it at mid off, and took the steepler when it finally came down
goes for the pull off a short delivery, but misses and is hit on the shoulder
clatter! another one, over long off this time, Naman gets front leg out of the way, and lofts another length ball down the ground, some start from Delhi
smoked! Naman does a Vijay, not quite the  pick-up shot, but he picks the off cutter and swings it from a length with the angle miles in to the crowd over deep midwicket
there is deep square leg in place now, and a gentle short delivery is pulled to that man, been lots of them today, the short ones

angles in the bouncer and Warner latches on to the pull, ends up hitting it high in the air, and Vijay runs hard and pulls it back in with a dive, even as the man running in from long leg has to jump over Vijay to avoid a collission
surprises him with a short one that takes off in to the ribs, he hops and manages to fend it away on the leg isde
short delivery banged in but Naman is quick to launch in to the pull, does not get it off the middle but enough to get it to the boundary finally
fuller delivery moving away in the air a shade, Naman gets forward and lofts it cleanly over covers with a firm push
gets half-forward and pushes a length ball back to the bowler, Doug fields and threatens to throw it back, then walks back with a smile
motors in and angles it on leg stump, off the pads to long leg
a touch close for the cut, Naman still goes hard at it, but it goes straight to point
in the channel outside off stump and he leaves it alone
leading edge, but that will beat mid off very comfortably, he wanted to turn this fuller one past midwicket, closed the face early and the ball flew over the off side infield
short of a length this time and he goes on the toes to keep it down on the off side
drives towards mid on, Vijay is quick on the ball, lets it rip and Warner has to dive in to his crease
length ball outside off stump, left alone quietly
